description: Sync contacts, invoices, payments and bank transactions from one Xero organisation, with files attached to contacts, invoices and bank transactions. Records link to their contact, and payments link to their invoice.
opening: Sync contacts, invoices, payments and bank transactions from one Xero organisation. Each record is one document. Invoices and bank transactions link to their contact, and payments link to the invoice they settle. Files attached to contacts, invoices and bank transactions are separate documents, and their text is searchable when the file can be downloaded and read.

Xero permissions are not imported, so every synced record is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Records deleted in Xero stay in HydraDB. Accounts, items, credit notes, quotes and other Xero objects are not synced.

connect.auth: Xero uses the client id and client secret of a Xero developer app, with a refresh token and the id of the organisation you connect.

credentials.name: client_id
credentials.text: The client id of your Xero app, from its Configuration page.

credentials.name: client_secret
credentials.text: The client secret of the same app.

credentials.name: refresh_token
credentials.text: A refresh token from completing Xero's OAuth flow for the organisation.

credentials.name: tenant_id
credentials.text: The id of the Xero organisation the tokens belong to.

credentials.name: access_token
credentials.text: Leave it empty. HydraDB obtains access tokens itself.

connect.credentials_note: A Xero refresh token can be used only once. Each time it is used, Xero issues a new one, and HydraDB stores it itself.

steps.title: Create a Xero app
steps.text: In the Xero developer portal, create an app and copy its client id and client secret.

steps.title: Authorise the organisation
steps.text: Complete Xero's OAuth flow for the organisation you want to connect. Copy the refresh token and the organisation's tenant id.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the values as `client_id`, `client_secret`, `refresh_token` and `tenant_id`. Saving the connector does not test the credentials, because a test would use up the single-use refresh token. The first sync is the test.

steps.title: Select the organisation
steps.text: Select the `All data` resource. It syncs contacts, invoices, payments, bank transactions and their attached files together. You cannot select individual contacts or invoices.

connect.account: One connector reads one Xero organisation.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads contacts, invoices, payments and bank transactions updated since the last sync. Attached files are checked for the contacts, invoices and bank transactions in that window.
sync.edits: An updated record replaces its document.
sync.deletes: Deleted records are not removed. A record deleted in Xero stays searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.xero_id
shared_attributes.text: The Xero id: the contact id, the invoice, payment or bank transaction id, or the attachment id. Finds one record. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's records. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: stream_type
shared_attributes.text: The record type, such as `contacts` or `invoices`.

shared_attributes.name: Other Xero fields
shared_attributes.text: The other fields HydraDB reads from Xero for the record. Kept for inspection only. A query does not match them and cannot filter on them.

documents.name: Contacts
documents.one_document: One contact: a customer or a supplier.
documents.title: The contact's name. Otherwise the first and last name.
documents.text: Contact details: the name, first and last name, email, phone numbers, lifecycle stage (the contact status), URL (the website), whether the contact is a person or an organization, the organization name and the update time. Then the name again, followed by `Email`, `Phones`, `Website`, `Status` and `Account number` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the contact was last updated in Xero.
documents.files: Files attached to a contact arrive as separate attachment documents linked to it.

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.text: The contact's name. It forms the title, and names a person contact in the graph.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.text: The contact's first name. Forms the title when there is no name, and makes the contact a person.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.text: The contact's last name. Forms the title when there is no name, and makes the contact a person.

attributes.name: email
attributes.text: The contact's email address. Identifies a person contact in the graph.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.text: Person when the contact has a first or last name, otherwise organization. Decides whether the graph records the contact as a person.

attributes.name: provider_user_id
attributes.text: The Xero contact id. Identifies a person contact in the graph. An organization contact is not made a person from it.

attributes.name: phones
attributes.text: The contact's phone numbers, without their area and country codes joined on.

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.text: The contact's name, when it differs from the person's name. Adds the organization to the contact details. It does not link the person to a separate company.

attributes.name: ContactStatus, Website, AccountNumber
attributes.text: The contact's status, website and account number.

attributes.name: UpdatedDateUTC
attributes.text: When the contact was last updated. It is the result date and appears in the contact details as `Updated`.

documents.name: Invoices
documents.title: `Invoice <number> - <contact>`. When a part is missing, the record type and id are used instead.
documents.text: The reference, then `Contact`, `Type`, `Status`, `Total` and `Amount due` with the currency, `Due date` and `Line items` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the invoice was last updated in Xero.
documents.link_back: The URL set on the invoice in Xero, when there is one. Otherwise none.
documents.files: Files attached to an invoice arrive as separate attachment documents linked to it.

attributes.name: Contact
attributes.text: The contact the invoice belongs to. Its id links the invoice to the contact's document. Its name is in the title and the `Contact` line. The id itself is not searchable.

attributes.name: InvoiceNumber
attributes.text: The invoice number, in the title.

attributes.name: Line items
attributes.text: Each line's description. Quantities, prices and account codes are stored but not searchable.

attributes.name: UpdatedDateUTC
attributes.text: When the invoice was last updated. Not searchable.

documents.name: Payments
documents.title: `Payment <amount> <currency> - <contact>`. When a part is missing, the record type and id are used instead.
documents.text: The reference, then `Contact`, `Invoice` (the invoice number), `Amount`, `Type`, `Status` and `Date` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the payment was last updated in Xero.

attributes.name: Invoice
attributes.text: The invoice the payment settles. Its id links the payment to the invoice's document. The invoice number and contact name are in the text, and the contact name can be in the title.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.text: The payment amount, with its currency when Xero supplies one. In the title and the `Amount` line.

attributes.name: UpdatedDateUTC
attributes.text: When the payment was last updated. Not searchable.

documents.name: Bank transactions
documents.title: `Bank transaction - <contact>`. When a part is missing, the record type and id are used instead.
documents.text: The reference, then `Contact`, `Type`, `Status`, `Total`, `Date` and `Line items` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the transaction was last updated in Xero.
documents.link_back: The URL set on the transaction in Xero, when there is one. Otherwise none.
documents.files: Files attached to a bank transaction arrive as separate attachment documents linked to it.

attributes.name: Contact
attributes.text: The contact the transaction belongs to. Its id links the transaction to the contact's document. Its name is in the title and the `Contact` line. The id itself is not searchable.

attributes.name: Line items
attributes.text: Each line's description. Quantities, prices and account codes are stored but not searchable.

attributes.name: UpdatedDateUTC
attributes.text: When the transaction was last updated. Not searchable.

documents.name: Attached files
documents.one_document: One file attached to a contact, an invoice or a bank transaction.
documents.title: The file name, or the attachment id when there is none.
documents.text: When the file is read, its text, followed by a `Data` section with the parent record's id and type. When it is not read, `Parent`, `Parent type`, `File` and `Content type` lines. The title is searchable either way.
documents.date: None. HydraDB does not keep when a file was added or changed.
documents.link_back: None that opens in the Xero app.
documents.files: Supported files are downloaded and read. When a file cannot be downloaded or read, only its details are searchable.

attributes.name: File text
attributes.text: The text read from the file, such as a receipt PDF.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The Xero id of the contact, invoice or bank transaction the file is attached to. Links the file to that record, and the graph places the file under it. Not a query filter.

attributes.name: ParentType
attributes.text: `contacts`, `invoices` or `bank_transactions`: the kind of record the file is attached to.

attributes.name: MimeType
attributes.text: The file's media type. Searchable only when the file was not read. Otherwise kept for inspection.

attributes.name: ContentLength
attributes.text: The file size in bytes.

example_searches: What is still due on invoice INV-0042 for Acme Ltd?
Which payments settled invoice INV-0042, and when?
What is the email and phone number for supplier Office Supplies Co?

connections: A bank transaction to its contact.
A payment to the invoice it settles.
An attached file to its contact, invoice or bank transaction, and under that record.
people: Each contact with a first or last name, as a person, identified by name, email and Xero contact id.
Other contacts are organizations. A person contact is not linked to a separate company.
graph.from_text: References, line descriptions, contact details and the text of attached files.

not_synced: Accounts, items, credit notes, purchase orders, quotes, journals, manual journals and other Xero objects.
Archived contacts. The connection form does not offer an option to include them.
Files attached to anything other than contacts, invoices and bank transactions.
Deletions: records deleted in Xero stay in HydraDB.
When an attached file was added or changed.
